text:
incident-bot: ALERT: INC-2026-EUW | embeddings-queue.depth > 90% for 6m; p99 generation latency 3.2s (↑x4). customer-facing 500s on regen endpoints reported. Paging primary. http://internal.incidents/INC-2026 :rotating_light:

alex: taking primary now. quick summary in thread — ongoing with eu-west embeddings cluster. currently: queue depth high, CPU on nodes ~85%, one node marked Unhealthy yesterday (rebooted), autoscaler hasn't added capacity yet. Maria is secondary until 02:00 UTC. Kev will cover the policy/fallback routing if needed.

maria: adding runbook pointers — see /runbooks/embeddings-queue and the playbook snippet below. I ran the preflight checks, KV cache hit rate is normal (~94%), so this looks like backpressure from generation workers not keeping up.

maria: ```steps:
1) check queue depth: `curl -s http://metrics/api?metric=embeddings.queue.depth`
2) check node health: `kubectl get pods -n embeddings -o wide`
3) trigger scale: `kubectl scale deployment embeddings-workers --replicas=12 -n embeddings`
4) if scale fails, switch routing to canary-variant: POST /routing/fallback {"variant":"embeddings-v2-lite"}```

alex: mitigations in progress: triggered a manual scale to 12 replicas (`kubectl scale`), requeued 2 stuck tasks (logs below), kicked a warm-up on the standby pool. Also toggled prefetch to 0.6 on the busiest route to reduce burst memory.

alex: logs for requeued tasks: ```ID: 7f4a2c - worker panic OOM -> restarted
ID: 9b3d1e - stuck at decode -> cleared by requeue
```

oncall-helper-bot: NOTE: autoscaler attempted 2x scale in last 30m but rejected due to quota in eu-west-accounts. Quota owner: infra-team. Raising infra-ticket #INF-782.

kevin: I can take a quick look at quota but I'm offsite in 30m. Quick plan: if infra can't bump quota immediately, we'll route low-priority regen to embeddings-v2-lite (lower perf but cheaper memory) and keep premium customers on current. I can push the routing change if you OK it, @alex. :thumbsup:

alex: yes, go ahead. prioritise customers flagged as "premium" in the routing table. I'll keep monitoring.

sam: question — any customer-impacting 500s counted by SLO alerts? Metrics show 12 unique customers saw >=1 500 in last 15m. We should notify CS if >5 high-usage accounts affected.

alex: good catch. Maria, please draft a short notification template. I'll send to CS and account reps after we stabilize queue < 60%.

maria: Draft below — feel free to edit: "We're investigating elevated generation latency and intermittent 500s for some customers in eu-west. We're actively scaling and routing lower-priority work to a compatible variant. We'll update in 30m or when resolved. If you see critical customer impact, ping me @maria."

oncall-helper-bot: ACTIONS TRACKER: [ ] scale to 12 (done) [ ] requeue stuck tasks (done) [ ] open INF-782 (open) [ ] routing patch for premium (in-progress) [ ] notify CS (pending) [ ] follow-up at 30m (pending)

alex: coverage notes — primary: me (until 01:00 UTC), secondary: maria (until 02:00 UTC), fallback: kevin (policy changes). Coverage gap: no APAC oncall tonight between 03:00-09:00 UTC; if this escalates after 03:00 we may need to page for volunteer coverage or handback to daylight crew.

maria: added escalation checklist: if queue depth >95% and p99 >4s for 10m -> declare SEV2, page SRE pager and exec rollback to embeddings-v1-legacy for regen endpoints, run customer mitigation runbook.

alex: I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for shift handoff. Next update in 12 minutes or when any action completes. React with :eyes: when you see this.

kevin: :eyes: I'm standing by to apply routing patch. If infra doesn't respond in 20m we'll implement soft-fallback.

incident-bot: Auto-update: queue depth steady at 78% (was 92%). p99 down to 2.1s. Autoscaler events: 1 scale-up attempt failed due to quota.

sam: looks like scaling helped but still above normal. Suggest keeping prefetch lowered and monitor memory on new replicas — we saw one OOM earlier.

alex: noted. I'll lower prefetch to 0.5 for all heavy routes and watch memory spike on new pods. If OOM recurs, rollback to previous image and reroute.

maria: sending CS note now. I'll paste the sent message here after to track.

alex: thanks — handoff plan for next oncall (02:00 UTC): - confirm queue < 60% - confirm no new 500s for premium customers - ensure INF-782 has an owner or routing fallback is in place - hand off to the 02:00 primary if stable

oncall-helper-bot: REMINDER scheduled follow-up at 30m (1950002768).

alex: signing off primary in 35m if stable, leaving thread for anyone to pick up.

maria: acknowledged, will watch through 02:00 and escalate if regressions.

kevin: will stand by for routing patch application.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED? no — still open. Latest state: mitigations active, partial improvement.
